# Listed buildings in Kingston, Kent

Kingston is a village and civil parish in the in the City of Canterbury district of Kent, England. It contains 16 listed buildings that are recorded in the National Heritage List for England. Of these one grade I and 15 are grade II.
This list is based on the information retrieved online from Historic England.
